name: AutoTiltAxisShiftAlignment
label: Auto Tilt Axis Shift Align
description: Automatically center images along the tilt axis

parameters.name: transform_source
parameters.label: Transformation Source
parameters.description: The source of the shift transformation value (i. e., generate it, load it from a file, etc.)

parameters.name: method
parameters.label: Method
parameters.description: Trial Reconstructions: reconstruct a few slices at whole-pixel shifts from -20 to +20 and keep the sharpest (any scan). Opposite Projections: compare projections 180 degrees apart, which for a parallel beam are mirror images about the axis; sub-pixel, any offset, and fast, but needs such pairs (scans over 180 degrees with both ends, or over 360).

parameters.name: sharpness_measure
parameters.label: Sharpness Measure
parameters.description: How the trial reconstructions are compared. Maximum: the brightest voxel. Gradient Energy: the mean squared gradient, which a misplaced axis lowers by smearing every edge; on test phantoms and on the NSLS-II HXN fluorescence example it picked the shift that reconstructs without doubled edges where the maximum did not.

parameters.name: padding
parameters.label: Padding
parameters.description: Array padding along non-tilt axes when determining the shift

parameters.name: num_slices
parameters.label: Number of Test Slices
parameters.description: Number of slices to randomly sample to determine ideal recon shift.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Random Number Generator Seed
parameters.description: Seed for the random number generator used to select slices. The seed is kept here so that when the pipeline is re-ran, the results are reproducible

parameters.name: apply_to_all_arrays
parameters.label: Apply to All Arrays
parameters.description: Apply the shift alignment to all arrays within this data source (not just the currently selected one). The shift is computed only using the currently selected array.

parameters.name: transforms_save_file
parameters.label: Save Transformations File
parameters.description: Save transformations file to apply to other datasets later. Leave this blank to not save it.
